value.name: Lucia challenges validity of mother's statements
value.description: Lucia refuses to accept the attorney's framing and says she has heard their mother say things before.
evidence: "s valid. I don't know what's valid. That's her job." Lucia tilted her head at Asha without looking at her. "I'm not going to sit here and pretend I never heard Mom say things."

value.name: Lucia mentions mother's joke about silver
value.description: Lucia provokes the room by repeating that their mother once said she would leave the silver to the cat.
evidence: "Mom said a lot of things. Mom said she was going to leave the silver to the cat."

value.name: Asha shuts down Lucia's provocation
value.description: Asha repeatedly tells Lucia to stop, signaling rising tension in the room.

value.name: Rosa remains detached from the argument
value.description: An uneasy silence passes, and Rosa stays focused on work while the others tense up.
evidence:
"There was a pause in which something old and ugly moved through the room and lay down again under the table. Asha breathed out very slowly through her nose.

"Rosa," she said, without turning. "Would you sit, please."

"I am working," Rosa said.

value.name: Asha asks Rosa to sit
value.description: Asha directs Rosa to take a seat, shifting the focus of the conversation toward her.
evidence: "Rosa," she said, without turning. "Would you sit, please."

value.name: Rosa chooses a neutral seat
value.description: Rosa sits between the attorney and the siblings, positioning herself at an equal distance from everyone.
evidence: Rosa came around the table, considered the empty chair across from Asha, and instead pulled out the chair to Asha's left, which placed her between the attorney and neither sibling, equidistant from all of them. She sat with her hands folded in her lap and her back straight and waited.

value.name: Asha questions Rosa about witnessing documents
value.description: Asha begins formal questioning by asking how long Rosa worked for Mrs. Serrano and whether she witnessed documents for her.
evidence: "Rosa," Asha said. "How long did you work for Mrs. Serrano?"
"And in that time, did you witness any documents on her behalf?"

value.name: Rosa reveals she witnessed two documents
value.description: Rosa states that she worked for Mrs. Serrano for thirty-one years and witnessed her will and another paper.
evidence: "Twice. Her will, in 2020. And another paper, last October."

value.name: Daniel objects angrily to Rosa's testimony
value.description: Daniel explodes at the implication of Rosa's statement and starts to challenge her credibility.
evidence: "Oh, for fuck's —" Daniel pushed back from the table.
"Rosa, I don't know what you think you saw, but you are not a lawyer, and my mother was on three different medications by October, and —"

value.name: Asha orders Daniel to sit down
value.description: Asha cuts Daniel off and commands him to sit, asserting control over the exchange.

value.name: Daniel resists before yielding to Asha
value.description: Daniel remains standing in anger, then sits only because Asha uses a voice that compels him.
evidence: He did not sit down. He stood with his hands on the back of the chair and his knuckles white.
